note: Ceilings for tools/route-budget.mjs: what a fresh visitor downloads per route, service worker blocked, in the published sources and a build. Each is the value measured at measuredAt plus 0.5% of its bytes and one request. Tight on purpose: every lesson route's ceiling is below what that route loaded before the transit and power-law families were made lazy, so a change that loads them eagerly again fails. Raised only by hand, in a commit that says why. The evaluation page's ceilings are measured after merging v2 at 489e4d2, where #36 made js/evaluationKit.js write through the shared js/csv.js (the spreadsheet-formula guard, 7.1 KB as served): 30.5 KB in 3 requests from the sources, 11.6 KB in 1 from the build.
